guitar.notes: Bob Seger is primarily a vocalist/songwriter; his Silver Bullet Band guitarists varied without one iconic signature setup.

tone.target: bright live rock crunch with punchy mids
tone.profile: bright live rock crunch with punchy mids
tone.summary: A clean, bright signal chain using a British amp model (UK 45) with light overdrive for crunch, complemented by room reverb to capture the live feel.
